text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is an original research article, not a review. Its primary objective is to evaluate carbon and water fluxes and stocks under climate and land-use change scenarios—not to develop or predict land-use/land-cover (LULC) change itself. The study uses refined regional LULC projections from Bezerra et al. (2022), generated externally using the LUCCME-BR model, as input data for driving the INLAND dynamic vegetation model. While the paper implements two future scenarios (SSP1-RCP2.6 and SSP3-RCP8.5) with national-scale spatial coverage of Brazil and includes mapped LULC inputs, it does not perform LULC prediction as its central research question, nor does it report quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC modeling (e.g., validation, error rates). Thus, LULC prediction is used as an input step rather than being the focus, meeting the definition of 'POSSIBLE'. All exclusion criteria are avoided, but core inclusion criteria related to primary focus on LULC prediction and accuracy reporting are not fulfilled.)
